comparison.objective: Open a locker while catching a box leaning on its door, then stand it on a mat; the candidate configures a gripper stop.
comparison.physical_skill: Support-transfer through a partially opened door and upright transport versus seated tools, countertorque, and angular adjustment.
comparison.success_condition: Box is never dropped or tipped and finishes upright on the mat; candidate requires locked target angle and repeated functional return.
comparison.reason: Hidden-load recovery and safe transport do not test coupled screw-and-locknut calibration.
